# Domo Cafe

> Domo Cafe (also called Domo Kun Cafe) is a character cafe at 8340 La Palma Ave, Buena Park, CA 90620. The cafe serves Japanese-inspired comfort food. Phone (415) 360-3666. Email info@domokuncafe.com.

Hours are Monday–Friday 11am–8pm and Saturday–Sunday 10am–9pm. Hours may vary on holidays. Walk-ins are welcome. Free parking is in the large Buena Park Downtown lot.

Domoween is Domo Cafe's Halloween event in Buena Park. It runs October 1 through November 1, 2026, during regular cafe hours. The page is https://domokuncafe.com/domoween/

Domo Hour is Monday through Friday, 3–6pm. The events calendar is the list of what is posted.

This file repeats facts published on the cafe's own pages. It does not list prices, a cover charge, performers, ratings, review counts, geo coordinates, or a founding date.
